Talent0_2Ability.name: Pochy!
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Auto deploy [Pochy] after sortie. The unit's Repair AMT is <color=#F74848>0.4x</color> Repair AMT of [Seven]'s Manipulator; [Pochy] can cast <buf ID=900021>[Pochy Repair]</buf>

Talent3_5Ability.name: Pochy!
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
Auto-deploy [Pochy] after sortie. The unit's Repair AMT is <color=#F74848>0.4x</color> that of [Seven]'s Manipulator. [Pochy] can now cast the <buf ID=900021>[Pochy Repair]</buf>.
[Pochy] will redeploy after being destroyed. This will take <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

500001.name: CEC 1
500001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

500502.name: Pochy Purification!
500502.SpecificEffects: When [Pochy] triggers <buf ID=900019>[Link Repair]</buf>, dispels <color=#F74848>2</color> debuffs after combat.

700009.name: Wide-Range Repair
700009.describe: Restores the HP of all allies within the selected <range type=1>Diamond (2 tiles) area</range>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. It can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part.

500504.name: Pochy Full-Auto!
500504.SpecificEffects: When an ally within <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles is attacked, [Pochy] automatically performs <buf ID=900020>[Assist Repair]</buf> on them after combat, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.75x</color> [Pochy]'s Repair AMT. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

500505.name: Pochy Overclock!
500505.SpecificEffects: When [Pochy] triggers <buf ID=900019>[Link Repair]</buf>, Repair AMT <color=#F74848>+25%</color> and can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> additional destroyed part.

500506.name: Pochy Station!
500506.SpecificEffects: Allow [Pochy] to shift to <buf ID=900039>[Rack]</buf> mode: unable to move. When an ally ends their action within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>3</color> tiles) area, automatically cast <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>, with a repair amount of <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> [Pochy]'s Repair AMT. In <buf ID=900039>[Rack]</buf> mode, the <buf ID=900026>[Retract]</buf> code is available. After retracting, [Pochy] can continue to move.

500507.name: Pochy Remote!
500507.SpecificEffects: If [Seven] executes <buf ID=5005071>[Specific Repair Skills]</buf> on targets beyond <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles of [Pochy], [Pochy] automatically selects the ally with the lowest HP in range to perform <buf ID=900019>[Link Repair]</buf>.

500508.name: Full Power!
500508.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.8x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. If Pochy is within <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles of the target, it performs <buf ID=900019>[Link Repair]</buf>, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>1x</color> Pochy's Repair AMT. This <buf ID=900019>[Link Repair]</buf> repairs all destroyed parts, dispels all debuffs, and applies <buf ID=7100703>[Defensive Stance III]</buf>, which can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time.

500509.name: Pochy Assist!
500509.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>1.8x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. If Pochy is within <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles of the target, performs <buf ID=900019>[Link Repair]</buf> and restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>1x</color> Pochy's Repair AMT.

500011.name: CEC 2
500011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500012.name: Part Maintenance 1
500012.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, dispel <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff.

500021.name: CEC 3
500021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

500031.name: Emergency Repair 1
500031.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, randomly select a single adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) ally to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT and cannot repair damaged parts.

500033.name: Flexible Repair
500033.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, an additional <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

500034.name: Emergency Repair 2
500034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> selects targets within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area.

500035.name: Emergency Repair 3
500035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>'s Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>1x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500036.name: Emergency Repair 4
500036.SpecificEffects: The number of targets that <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> can repair increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

500541.name: Pochy 2.0 1
500541.SpecificEffects: [Pochy]'s inherited Repair AMT has been increased to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> of [Seven]'s Repair AMT.

500043.name: Part Maintenance 3
500043.SpecificEffects: Each turn, the AP Cost of the 1st repair skill decreases by <color=#F74848>1</color>, with a minimum cost of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500544.name: Pochy 2.0 2
500544.SpecificEffects: When [Pochy] suffers overdamage, trigger <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking to <color=#F74848>1</color> HP. This effect is only effective for <color=#F74848>1</color> time per deployment.
